title: Voice authentication localizes public guides and parses private confirmation and OTP locally
steps: Run the named tests with fixed translation fixtures and own headless synthetic microphone/STT/TTS. Never send mail or invoke real providers.
expect: Only language and fixed public templates reach translation; credentials and private history are rejected before inference.
Invalid placeholders, confirmation collisions and unchanged English guides for another language fail closed.
Cached concurrent language requests translate once; unavailable localization never silently switches to English.
French spoken email, oui and six French digits verify on the same microphone after explicit confirmation, without credentials in model turns.
Unicode decimal digits and localized non-Latin digit words parse exactly; surrounding unknown words and excess digits are refused.
fence: Language-only public-template localization and validated local lexicon/FSM. Fixtures do not prove actual provider coverage for all languages.

tests: language pack uses existing assistant for fixed public templates only; cache/coalescing and validation fail closed
auth-language route accepts language only and rejects credentials before any translation
locale lexicon handles spoken email, localized readback, Unicode digits and non-Latin six-digit words
dynamic guide requests contain language only; no silent English fallback or mismatched stale language
French voice sign-in loads public instructions and verifies localized confirmation and digits privately
